burst tail: same arrival, later stamp
sequence gap of 2 raises loss pressure
recovery: healthy delivery decays loss pressure
ACK-only stream switch with no producer stamp resets the clock
new stream's first stamped frame re-anchors
downward clock step: producer stamp jumps back
uint32 wrap: near-max sequence then zero
reconcile with ack=1 replays inputs 2 and 3
re-acking the same sequence is a no-op

overflow evicts the oldest unacknowledged input
reset seeded with a cumulative ack
ack across the wrap drains both wrapped entries
bare reset clears the ack frontier
any sequence is accepted after a bare reset
